summary: More dellemc.openmanage changes in Ansible 12: idrac_user, idrac_user_info and idrac_virtual_media support iDRAC10, ome_firmware modules support OME 4.5, new omevv baseline profile, compliance and firmware modules, and redfish modules support iDRAC10.
